# Nasend — llms.txt
# Files between your devices, without a server.

## Overview
- Free, open-source application under the MIT License. Universal Android APK (Phone, Tablet, Android TV) and Windows EXE (Standalone Portable and NSIS Setup).
- Every device runs an embedded FileProto file server (port 8743) and client.
- Devices pair using an 8-character Crockford Base32 single-use code with a 5-minute expiry.
- LAN operations communicate over direct TCP sockets via local mDNS.
- WAN operations communicate over WebRTC DataChannels using DTLS 1.3 encryption.
- An ephemeral Cloudflare Worker (Durable Object) brokers WebRTC signaling only (SDP/ICE). File bytes never touch the server.
